Name: Personal Anvil
Author: strobel1ght
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xmv2Wqt.png[/img]

You can buy the anvil at the Blacksmith shop when you have the following conditions met:
[list=1]
[*]At least [u]5 Hearts with Clint[/u]
[*]Cracked at least [u]50 Geodes[/u]
[/list]
The [b]Anvil[/b] allows you to crack geodes, treasure troves, golden coconuts and mystery boxes wherever you want, free of cost.
Also gives you [b]Mining XP! [/b][i](You are cracking geodes yourself, after all)[/i]


[u][b]Requirements:[/b][/u]
- Latest version of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]SMAPI[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]
[/url]
[b][u]Installation:[/u][/b]
2. Unzip the downloaded .zip file into your Mods folder.
